meta.title: Ba Na Hills Overnight Stay Full Review | Worth It For the Perks?
meta.description:
In this vlog, we share our full experience of staying overnight at the Mercure Ba Na Hills Hotel - and why it’s absolutely worth it. From exploring the French Village after dark with no crowds, to enjoying Fantasy Park without queues, and best of all, having exclusive access to the Golden Bridge at sunrise before the gates open to the public… this was one of the most incredible travel experiences we’ve had in Vietnam.

In this video, we’ll show you how to make the most of your time at Ba Na Hills. We cover:

- How to get there from Da Nang
- What it’s like to check in and ride the record-breaking cable car
- Show you around the Fantasy Park and French Village at night & Beer Plaza after the crowds leave
- Exploring the spiritual zones, Linh Ung Pagoda & stunning entertainment and views from the Lunar Castle
- Review the room and overall stay - it exceeded expectations 
- Showcase the food and drink available 
- All the perks that come with staying overnight - including the priceless experience that is experiencing the GOLDEN BRIDGE all to yourself, WITHOUT THE CROWDS. 

Ba Na Hills is Vietnam’s premier tourist attraction - but staying overnight turns it into a premium, unforgettable experience. If you’re visiting Da Nang, this is a MUST-DO!

✨ Are you in Da Nang and thinking about staying overnight at Ba Na Hills? ✨
